job.title: Software Engineer I, Backend (Streaming Infra)
job.pay: $130K – $180K a year (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT)
job.pay_full: $130,000 – $180,000 a year base pay in CA, WA, NY, NJ and CT; $115,000 – $165,000 a year in all other US states

details.about: Affirm offers a clear, predictable way to pay over time with no hidden fees or compounding interest. Its Streaming team owns data at the company and sets the strategy for event-driven architecture, stream processing, data exploration, discovery and validation, using open-source tools such as Kafka, Flink and Spark and building its own where needed.
duties: Work on tasks that move the team's projects and goals forward, with the team's support
Collaborate with your team and stakeholders, making risks and trade-offs in your work visible
Balance speed and quality to hit business goals while protecting systems from downtime
Contribute to the team's community through growth and development activities
needs: Work or internship experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale
Familiarity with distributed-systems building blocks and technologies such as AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes
Turning a business problem into clear, well-tested, extensible code across multiple components
Comfort navigating a large codebase, debugging others' code and giving code-review feedback
A Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience
nice: Experience building and owning large-scale stream processing systems such as Kafka or SNS
details.benefits: Base pay $130,000 – $180,000 a year in CA, WA, NY, NJ and CT, and $115,000 – $165,000 a year in all other US states; new employees typically start at the beginning of the range. Total compensation may include equity. Benefits include 100% of medical, dental and vision premiums covered for employees and dependents, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech, flexible time off, generous holidays and an employee stock purchase plan.
notes: Remote-first: most roles can be done from almost anywhere in the country of employment
All new hires are invited to an in-person onboarding
Affirm offers accommodations for candidates with disabilities during interviews
